title: Spellbooks
description: This project adds new spellbooks to the game with unique ability's. These spellbooks can generate or get crafted, they also all have custom advancements.
body:
![Image of the name of the datapack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41ad1b0bb143ab30f617a8c0eb03d5e5edcfeba7.png)

Spellbooks adds eight new spells for use in survival minecraft. It also adds a brand new mana system. Every player recharges two mana every two seconds and has a max mana of one hundred.

![The Mana System](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2239ef339fc3db0c47417e124e2629ec38bb698a.png)

We Have Some Things Other Datapacks don't!

- Multiplayer friendly datapack!
- Doesn't need a resource pack to run!

## All Known Issues
- None Yet Known

## Old Issues
- Burn spell will instead of targeting normal entities it may target an item. - Fixed in Release v1.0.0
- Poison spell will instead of targeting normal entities it may target an item. - Fixed in Release v1.0.0
- The fire from the burn spell may replace slabs, trapdoors, or any non-ful block if a targeted player is standing in one. Fixed in Release v1.0.0
- Burn caster tag will remain (Only hurts multiplayer gameplay) - Fixed in Release v1.0.0
- Neither teleport spells currently work. - Fixed in Beta v1.0.2
- Poison spell only requires 15 mana to cast when it removes 18 and should require 18. - Fixed in Beta v1.0.1
- Decay spell will instead of targeting normal entities it may target an item. - Fixed in Beta v1.0.1
